leadText:
Kasukarp (Japanese: カスキング Kasuking) is a character of the day who appeared in Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown!. In addition to being a ten-time winner of the annual Magikarp High Jump Competition, he is also a .

Kasukarp competed in the tenth annual Magikarp High Jump Competition using his , where it went up against Goh and his giant Magikarp. Kasukarp was ultimately declared the winner when Goh's own Magikarp jumped so high that it went into space and didn't land in time.

Kasukarp later visited 's base, only for James to shut the door on him.
